method: AI-generated draft annotations based on customer messages and visible prior context.
human_review_status: Not yet reviewed by a human.
permission_basis: User reports revised assignment wording: students can use AI for all tasks. Not independently verified.
evaluation_limit: These labels are not independent human ground truth. Do not report AI-versus-AI agreement as human agreement. Test examples were seen during annotation; avoid tuning the system on them.
label_policy: Label the current request using visible ancestors; do not infer future replies or private messages.
Retain an unresolved issue when the latest turn supplies details or says yes.
Use praise_thanks for thanks or explicit successful closure; complaint-only closure stays with the complaint category.
Account access includes identity settings and account privacy. Plans includes entitlement, geographic access, and plan how-to.
Music library includes catalog, metadata, playlist management, and local-file syncing. Playback includes offline downloads and shuffle faults.
Auto-handle means a safe response or clarification is possible, not that the problem is solved.
Escalate for security concerns, disputed charges, inaccessible support cases, account investigation, catalog corrections, or repeated failed troubleshooting.
Use historical material as evidence of past support, not current prices, feature availability, launch dates, or live service status.
French and Portuguese examples are retained; multilingual judgments need human review.
